narrative.overview: Preserve Arcanium Digital's existing identity and source components. The user authorised an isolated seller conversation demo, not a site redesign. This document records observed code and the reviewed desktop/mobile interface; it introduces no replacement brand strategy.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black surfaces with lilac and purple accents.
Inter body text, Space Grotesk display text and the existing Arcanium logo.
Scoped demo controls with visible labels, numbered steps and explicit feedback.
dos: Do preserve the existing logo, fonts, palette and source components.
Do keep demo-specific measurements and two-step composition scoped to `/seller-demo`.
Do retain the visible demo boundary, labelled controls, focus feedback and truthful chat-history wording.
donts: Don't introduce a redesign or change incumbent site and live lead behaviour through this reference.
Don't promote the native GHL widget's appearance into the Arcanium design system.
Don't treat interface review as evidence of production lead delivery or provider lifecycle readiness.
